tablesPage.purposeBody: Registration is what puts a table into the governed model: it fixes the columns, the names they are exposed under, and which roles can see them. Only registered tables can be queried, and everything downstream — relationships, metrics, views, glossary terms — names registered columns.
tablesPage.purposeAdd: + View defines a relation from SQL or from metrics instead of from a physical table. + Model builds an entity or fact (star schema / Data Vault) and registers whatever it lowers to.
tablesPage.erdHelpBody: Draws the registered tables and the relationships declared between them, so the joins that already exist are visible before you write a query. It reads the model rather than editing it: filter by domain and export the diagram as PNG or SVG.
